200:t_2:5.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「I'm just glad you're safe, $$バナージ$$.」

200:t_2:6.en:
$$バナージ$$
「...Is your body all right?」

200:t_2:7.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Even in a situation like this, you worry about others. That's so like you.」

200:t_2:9.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「There's no need to worry. Thanks to Director $$ナナイ$$, I'm stable now.」

200:t_2:10.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「The $$ガランシェール$$ crew has decided to fight under Colonel $$シャア$$.」

200:t_2:11.en:
$$バナージ$$
「The Captain and the others, too...」

200:t_2:12.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「That's right. There is no Federation or $$ジオン$$ now... There is something we have to do for the sake of everyone.」

200:t_2:13.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「That I can think this way at all is thanks to the experience of fighting alongside you all. I'm counting on you from here on, $$バナージ$$.」

200:t_2:15.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「What are one or two failures?」

200:t_2:16.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「As long as you live, you struggle with everything you have... Isn't that who you are, $$バナージ$$?」

200:t_2:18.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「You and the Master showed me the light. I want to repay you for it, even if only a little.」

200:t_2:20.en:
$$シャア$$
「There's no need to worry about $$マリーダ$$. She is fighting of her own will.」

200:t_2:21.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...You saved us, $$シャア$$. If you and $$葵$$ and the others hadn't come, we might have been wiped out right there.」

200:t_2:22.en:
$$シャア$$
「The $$新地球皇国$$... Its strength seems to have far exceeded our imagination.」

200:t_2:23.en:
$$シャア$$
「I secured a retreat route just in case, and I'm glad it proved useful.」

200:t_2:24.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Three $$スフィア・リアクター$$s... With our current strength, if we fight them all at once, we have no chance of winning.」

200:t_2:25.en:
$$シャア$$
「So you haven't lost hope yet.」

200:t_2:26.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I'm one of $c too, after all. If we can't do it now, all that's left is to think about what to do from here on.」

200:t_2:27.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You understand that too, don't you?」

200:t_2:29.en:
$$シャア$$
「I'll travel with you for the time being. Once things settle down, I'll return to space, though.」

200:t_2:31.en:
$$シャア$$
「Now that $$プラント$$ has also shown its support for $$ネオ・ジオン$$, unless we hurry, every Spacenoid will end up on the Empire's side.」

200:t_2:32.en:
$$シャア$$
「I'm leaving $$マリーダ$$ with you. $$クェス$$ is here too, and above all, the atmosphere here suits her.」

200:t_2:33.en:
$$アムロ$$
「From here on, we may end up under endless pursuit by the Empire, you know.」

200:t_2:34.en:
$$シャア$$
「Even so, she says she wants to fight here.」

200:t_2:35.en:
$$シャア$$
「If possible, I would like to as well.」

200:t_2:36.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Understood. ...I owe you a great debt.」

200:t_2:37.en:
$$シャア$$
「No... You stopped $$アクシズ$$, so we're even.」

200:t_2:38.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I guess so. It may be for a short while, but I'll be relying on you.」

200:t_2:39.en:
$$シャア$$
「Here, I'll do my part as just one pilot.」

200:t_2:40.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The pursuit force has come already, huh.」

200:t_2:41.en:
$$シャア$$
(As I thought, the Empire is setting its sights on $c...)

200:t_2:42.en:
$$シャア$$
(The vision of despair I saw when I became a $$特異点$$... Is that time drawing near...?)

200:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's not some supernatural thing like getting caught in a $$時空震動$$. It's bad purely as a war...!」

200:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So, the celebration for our ace pilots will have to wait for another occasion!」

200:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「With a dimensional merchant's grit, only the $$Ｄトレーダー$$ stays open for business! So, today, by sheer force... business, business!」

201:t_000:1.en:
$$フェルト$$
「The Imperial Palace at $$ラース・バビロン$$ is already within combat range!」

201:t_001:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
「So that's where the Emperor of the $$新地球皇国$$ is...」

201:t_001:1.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「That building looks stuck-up just by the look of it.」

201:t_001:2.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Yeah. Looking down on Earthlings from way up there, it must have felt pretty good.」

201:t_001:3.en:
$$ガロード$$
「But that ends here...! Now that we're here!」

201:t_001:4.en:
$$スザク$$
「We haven't met anything you could call resistance so far, but...」

201:t_001:6.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「What do you make of it, $$ゼロ$$?」

201:t_001:7.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Since it's the imperial capital, I'm well aware that schemes of some kind have been laid out.」

201:t_001:8.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「But if the enemy plays with schemes, we will break through them head-on...! Against trickery, the righteous path - that is the road to victory!」

201:t_001:9.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Our strength is on par with what we had at the decisive battle of the $$時獄戦役$$. We've done everything we could at this point.」

201:t_001:10.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「The analysis of both sides' strength also shows a chance of victory if it's a quick breakthrough operation. All that's left is to carry it out.」

201:t_001:11.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Our target is the Imperial Palace... That is where all the $$レイライン$$ converge...」

201:t_001:12.en:
$$刹那$$
「If we strike it, we can stop the extraction of $$次元力$$ too...!」

201:t_001:13.en:
$$オットー$$
「Are you all ready!? We're charging in!」

201:t_001:14.en:
$$レイアム$$
「All units, be careful! The defense forces are coming out!」

201:t_002:0.en:
$$ルナマリア$$
「That's a huge number. Though I expected it.」

201:t_002:1.en:
$$シン$$
「As expected of the capital where the Emperor lives!」

201:t_002:4.en:
$n
「Too bad. It was a chance to pay back that $$尸空#pilot$$ and $$バルビエル$$.」

201:t_002:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「But don't let your guard down. Our opponents are that sneaky bastard and a killer.」

201:t_002:6.en:
$$セツコ$$
「They're surely holding back in the rear...!」

201:t_002:7.en:
$$カレン$$
「Then we'll drag them out and blast through them along with everything else!」

201:t_002:8.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Our target is the Imperial Palace! Scatter the small fry around it!」

201:t_002:9.en:
$$アムロ$$
「All units, the first phase of the operation is to break through the enemy's defense line.」

201:t_003:0.en:
$$オズマ$$
「If we can't cross that line in four minutes, the operation fails!」

201:t_003:1.en:
$$カトル$$
「In four minutes, against this many enemies...」

201:t_003:2.en:
$$五飛$$
「We're prepared for a hard fight!」

201:t_004:1.en:
$$勝平$$
「Come on if you're coming, $$サイデリアル$$!」

201:t_004:3.en:
$$タケル$$
「This battle... we'll win for sure!」

201:t_004:4.en:
$$ラルク$$
「We won't let you have your way with Earth!」

kept_omissions: 200:t_2:14: 'But we...' (subject truncated in Japanese; Banagher's 'でも、俺達は…' left open)
200:t_2:27: 'You understand that too' (object left implicit as in Japanese; 'that' = the need to think about the future)
201:t_001:12: 'If we strike it' (subject of 叩けば is the group; written as 'we')
201:t_003:1/3:4 shouts kept bare as in Japanese (no addressee needed)
uncertain: 200:t_2:18: マスター (Marida's 'Master') rendered 'the Master' - referent unknown to me, not in the glossary.
200:t_2:12: bare 連邦 has no token; used plain 'the Federation' (no token proposal; 地球連邦 token would read 'Earth Federation').
201:t_002:2: bare リアクター rendered plain 'Reactors' (no token for the short form).
200:t_2:11: bare キャプテン rendered 'the Captain' (presumably Zinnerman of the Garencieres; Japanese gives no name).
201:t_002:5: ド陰険野郎 and 殺し屋 taken as Shikuu and Barbiel respectively.
200:t_2:21: 葵達 = 'Aoi and the others' using the 葵 token (Aoi, female).
200:t_2:42: 特異点化した私 = 'when I became a Singularity' (token 特異点).
